Exercises › Glutes

How to do the Dumbbell Hip Thrust

A beginner compound exercise for the glutes.

How to do it

  1. Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, knees bent, feet flat, and a dumbbell across your hips.
  2. Brace your core and drive through your heels, lifting your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
  3. Squeeze your glutes powerfully at the top of the movement, ensuring full hip extension.
  4. Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position with control, maintaining tension.
  5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Muscles worked

Primary
Glutes
Secondary
Hamstrings and Quads
Equipment
Dumbbells, Flat bench or Adjustable bench
Level
Beginner
